most_similar_reason: Candidate 4 is essentially the same narrative: a great god incarnates as a prince to destroy a demon king, wins a princess by breaking/stringing a bow at a contest, is exiled to the forest with his brother, rejects and mutilates a demoness, has his wife abducted by the demon king, allies with monkey-people after restoring their king against a usurping brother, and with a devoted monkey ally locates his wife and defeats the demon king.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 6 shares nothing beyond a supernatural being interacting with humans—it is a revelation story about a sacred woman bringing ceremonies and a pipe, with no incarnating god, demon king, abducted wife, animal allies, or heroic war.
